name: StoryChief
description_en:
StoryChief is a hosted content operations platform for planning, drafting, reviewing and distributing articles and social content. It connects an editorial workspace to existing websites, social networks and email tools; it is not automatically the hosting platform or complete replacement for the destination CMS. AI drafting, repurposing and visibility tracking are separately metered parts of the offer.

Its useful unit of evaluation is one approved story and its destination-specific versions. Budget the workspace, users, websites/social channels, article allowances, AI credits and tracked prompts together. Connection support, API access and approvals vary by plan and destination; listing a CMS in the directory does not prove compatibility with every current version.
description_zh:
StoryChief 是托管内容运营平台，用于规划、起草、审阅及分发文章和社交内容，将编辑工作区连接现有网站、社交网络及邮件工具；它并不自动成为目标网站的主机或完整替代CMS。AI起草、改写及可见度跟踪是分别计量的能力。

评估单位可是一篇已批准内容及其各渠道版本。预算应同时计算工作区、用户、网站/社交渠道、文章额度、AI积分及跟踪提示。连接支持、API访问和审批随套餐及目标而异，集成目录列出某CMS不证明兼容其全部当前版本。

core_features.explanation_zh: 提供共享编辑、评论和公开审阅链接；当前表格从Growth起包含审批工作流。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect a CMS/social/email destination and tailor content, media, timing and metadata according to its supported capabilities.
core_features.explanation_zh: 连接CMS/社交/邮件目标，再按其支持能力调整内容、媒体、时间和元数据。

core_features.explanation_en: Monthly generation credits, recurring capacity and nonexpiring top-ups differ from tracked AI-search prompts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每月生成积分、订阅扩容及不过期充值，与AI搜索提示跟踪为不同额度。

sections.title_en: Take one article through review and channel adaptation
sections.title_zh: 让一篇文章完成审阅及渠道适配
sections.en:
An illustrative workflow is to brief a product announcement, draft the article with an editor, collect comments, obtain the required approval, then publish to a connected CMS and adapt a shorter message for LinkedIn. Use the destination’s own fields, schedule and media rather than assuming every channel accepts the same output. The distribution page describes master content with channel overrides and links between versions; its reach and engagement illustrations are not outcomes verified here.

The CMS still needs its own working site, templates and access. Verify the article, canonical URL, category/media mapping and update/unpublish result at each selected destination. The vendor qualifies drafts, scheduling and removal by destination support. This research did not connect accounts or publish content.
sections.zh:
例如先为产品公告写brief，与编辑共同起草文章、收集评论、完成所需审批，再发布到已连接CMS，并为LinkedIn改写短消息。应使用目标自身字段、定时和媒体要求，不能假定所有渠道接受相同输出。分发页描述主内容及渠道覆盖、版本关联，但其中触达及互动示例不是本次核实的成果。

CMS仍需自身站点、模板及权限，需逐目标检查文章、canonical URL、分类/媒体映射及更新/撤回结果。厂商对草稿、定时和移除都附目标支持条件，本次未连接账户或发布内容。

sections.title_en: Choose a workflow tier before comparing seat costs
sections.title_zh: 比较席位价前先选工作流档位
sections.en:
The current table gives Starter1user,4social channels,25articles/month,15,000AI credits and no tracked prompts; it includes shared editing/comments/review links but not approval workflows. Growth includes5users,10channels,100articles,25,000credits and10tracked prompts, adding approvals, tasks and campaign-level tools. Scale includes10users,25channels,unlimited articles,50,000credits and25prompts, with translations and higher-capacity operations. Each lists2websites. Unlimited articles do not mean unlimited AI use or destinations.

Agency is priced per client workspace, with unlimited users/articles,10social channels,25,000credits and10prompts per workspace. Enterprise adds contracted rollout, integration, SSO/SLA/security procurement scope. A feature available throughout the trial may therefore be unavailable in the plan purchased afterward.
sections.zh:
当前表格中Starter为1用户、4社交渠道、每月25文章、15,000AI积分且无跟踪提示，含共享编辑/评论/审阅链接，但不含审批工作流。Growth含5用户、10渠道、100文章、25,000积分及10提示，并增加审批、任务及活动级工具；Scale含10用户、25渠道、不限文章、50,000积分及25提示，提供翻译和更高容量。各档均列2网站，不限文章不等于AI或目标渠道无限。

Agency按客户工作区收费，每工作区不限用户/文章、10社交渠道、25,000积分及10提示；Enterprise增加约定上线、集成、SSO/SLA及安全采购范围。因此试用中可用的功能未必存在于最终购买套餐。

sections.title_en: Compare term, currency and add-ons on the same basis
sections.title_zh: 以相同周期、币种及附加项比较
sections.en:
The page displays EUR and USD monthly/annual pairs. In USD, Starter is69monthly or59/month with708billed yearly; Growth339or279/month with3,348yearly; Scale539or449/month with5,388yearly. Agency shows97monthly or81/month with972billed yearly per workspace. Enterprise displays a starting1,000+EUR/month with yearly or negotiated multi-year billing, not a verified USD quote. Taxes, checkout eligibility and renewal terms were not established.

Starter allows up to3total users, with extra seats displayed atUSD25monthly or19/month annually. Growth/Scale also sell extra seats; extra social channels showUSD7monthly or6/month yearly. The no-card trial includes all features/add-ons, but a specific trial length was not verified. The free-start wording is not evidence of an ongoing free plan.
sections.zh:
页面同时显示欧元/美元及月付/年付价格。美元Starter月付69，或年付月均59、全年708；Growth为339或年付月均279、全年3,348；Scale为539或年付月均449、全年5,388。Agency每工作区月付97或年付月均81、全年972。Enterprise显示起价每月1,000+欧元，按年或协商多年付款，不能当作已核实美元报价。税费、结账适用条件及续费条款未建立。

Starter最多共3用户，额外席位显示美元月付25或年付月均19；Growth/Scale也销售额外席位，额外社交渠道美元月付7或年付月均6。无需信用卡的试用包含全部功能/附加项，但本次未核实具体时长。“免费开始”不证明有持续免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Keep generated content credits separate from monitored prompts
sections.title_zh: 区分生成积分与监测提示
sections.en:
Included AI credits refresh monthly. The recurring AI add-on displaysUSD60monthly or45/month billed yearly, adding50,000credits/month and20tracked prompts. One-time packs displayUSD25for10,000credits,60for25,000and120for50,000; they do not expire, and the FAQ says monthly credits are consumed first. A top-up adds usage to features already enabled, so it does not necessarily unlock image/video generation.

There is a scope inconsistency worth confirming: add-on copy says it unlocks image and video, while the comparison table gives Growth image generation and Scale/Agency both without that add-on. Follow the selected plan’s written entitlement, not an assumed universal rule. Tracked prompts monitor appearances in AI answers; they are not writing credits or a guarantee of citations. Generated facts, translations and brand claims still need human review.
sections.zh:
内含AI积分每月刷新。订阅AI附加包显示美元月付60或年付月均45，每月增加50,000积分及20跟踪提示。一次性包为10,000积分25美元、25,000积分60美元、50,000积分120美元，不会过期；FAQ称先用每月积分。充值增加现有已开通功能用量，不一定解锁图像/视频。

范围存在需确认的不一致：附加包文案称解锁图像和视频，但比较表显示Growth已含图像、Scale/Agency已含两者。应以所选套餐书面权益为准，不能套用统一规则。跟踪提示监测AI回答中的出现，并非写作积分或引用保证；生成事实、翻译和品牌主张仍需人工复核。

sections.title_en: Check connector versions and custom implementation work
sections.title_zh: 检查连接器版本及定制实施工作
sections.en:
The integration catalogue mixes native CMS channels, social/email tools, embedded media and webhook/headless options. These are different kinds of connection, not450identical publishing capabilities. The table limits REST API and Custom Website API to Scale/Agency/Enterprise. A custom website setup requires adding a separate destination for each website and implementing/configuring a webhook with a developer before saving the channel.

A concrete compatibility gap appears in the Statamic guide: it requires an installed addon and explicitly says it supportsStatamicv2/v3, whereas the Statamic documentation read for this batch is6.x. A catalogue entry alone cannot establish6.xcompatibility; obtain current supported versions or scope a custom connection. Treat keys as credentials and test error/retry behavior, media and updates without duplicating posts.

Setup sources: [custom website API guide](https://help.storychief.io/en/articles/483667-connect-to-your-website-with-our-api), [Statamic connector guide](https://help.storychief.io/en/articles/4578252-connect-your-statamic-website).
sections.zh:
集成目录混合原生CMS渠道、社交/邮件工具、媒体嵌入及webhook/无头选项，属于不同连接方式，不能当作450种相同发布能力。套餐表将REST API及Custom Website API限于Scale/Agency/Enterprise。定制网站需每站各建一个目标，由开发者实现/配置webhook后保存渠道。

Statamic指南暴露具体兼容缺口：要求先装扩展，并明确支持Statamicv2/v3，而本批实读Statamic文档为6.x。仅有目录条目不能证明6.x兼容，需取得当前支持版本或规划定制连接。密钥应按凭据处理，并测试错误/重试、媒体和更新，避免重复发布。

设置来源：[定制网站API指南](https://help.storychief.io/en/articles/483667-connect-to-your-website-with-our-api)、[Statamic连接指南](https://help.storychief.io/en/articles/4578252-connect-your-statamic-website)。

sections.title_en: Pilot the real review and publication boundaries
sections.title_zh: 试点验证真实审阅及发布边界
sections.en:
StoryChief is plausible for a marketing/editorial team distributing content through an existing stack, or an agency separating client workspaces. A simple single-channel site may not need this additional operations layer. The pricing FAQ identifies an English interface and publishing support for35+languages/dialects; content-language support should not be read as a localized interface guarantee.

A useful pilot is one reviewed article and two tailored social posts: verify approver rights, destination authentication, scheduled/public states, updates/removal and reporting. Confirm export/data retention, permissions on public review links, vendor/AI data handling, cancellation and failed-delivery recovery before committing sensitive workflows. None of those account-level behaviors, publication results or visibility improvements were tested here.
sections.zh:
需要通过现有工具栈分发内容的营销/编辑团队，或需隔离客户工作区的代理机构可评估StoryChief。简单单渠道站未必需要额外内容运营层。定价FAQ称界面为英语，内容发布支持35种以上语言/方言，不能将内容语言支持当作本地化界面保证。

试点可用一篇经审阅文章及两条定制社交消息，检查审批权限、目标认证、定时/公开状态、更新/移除及报告。涉及敏感流程前，需确认导出/数据保留、公开审阅链接权限、厂商/AI数据处理、取消及失败投递恢复。本次未测试上述账户级行为、发布结果或可见度改善。

research_gaps.en: Statamic guide namesv2/v3; compatibility with current6.xand any other specific CMS version was not tested. No connector, approval, delivery/retry, reporting or AI outcome was executed.
